market_question: US x Iran permanent peace deal by June 30, 2026?
reasoning: US-Iran adversarial relationship spans over 40 years with no permanent peace treaty. A temporary ceasefire announced in April 2026 does not signal a permanent resolution; deep ideological, regional, and nuclear disagreements make a comprehensive peace deal by mid-2026 extremely unlikely.
evidence_points: No permanent peace or normalization has occurred since the 1979 Iranian Revolution
The resolution criteria require an explicit agreement ending all military hostilities permanently, a far higher bar than a temporary ceasefire
Domestic political constraints in both the US and Iran strongly oppose normalization, and the timeline is too short to overcome entrenched mistrust
sources_consulted: Historical analysis of US-Iran diplomatic relations
News reports on recent ceasefire and ongoing negotiations
Expert commentary on Iran-US conflict dynamics
